tagline: We create products to enhance residential and commercial spaces around the world.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net sales is the company's primary performance indicator, as it directly reflects Mohawk's ability to generate revenue from its global flooring manufacturing and distribution operations across its three core segments.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Net sales is a key indicator of the company's performance.
kpis.signal: Net sales reached $10.8 billion in 2025, slightly down compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Global Ceramic Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales of ceramic products on a global scale.
kpis.description: Global ceramic sales represent 40% of total revenue and are a key performance indicator for the company's operations in the ceramic sector.
kpis.signal: Global ceramic sales reached $4.3 billion in 2025, up compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Flooring North America Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales of flooring in North America.
kpis.description: Flooring North America sales represent 34% of total revenue and reflect the impact of challenging U.S. housing market conditions.
kpis.signal: Flooring North America sales reached $3.7 billion in 2025, down compared to 2024.

kpis.short: Flooring Rest of the World Sales
kpis.name: Flooring Rest of the World Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales of flooring in the rest of the world.
kpis.description: Flooring Rest of the World sales represent 26% of total revenue and reflect Mohawk's international operations in 19 countries.
kpis.signal: Flooring Rest of the World sales reached $2.8 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key profitability indicator for the company and reflects the impact of higher input costs.
kpis.signal: Gross margin reached 23.9% in 2025, down compared to 24.8% in 2024.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the company's operating profitability before interest and taxes, impacted by restructuring charges and integration costs.
kpis.signal: Operating margin reached 4.5% in 2025, significantly down compared to 6.4% in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.description: Net earnings is a key indicator of the company's financial performance, impacted by higher input costs and restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Net earnings reached $369.9 million in 2025, significantly down compared to $514.7 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: CAPEX is a key indicator of the company's investment in its assets and reflects its cost optimization strategy in a challenging market environment.
kpis.signal: CAPEX reached $440 million in 2025, down 30% compared to 2024, reflecting a disciplined capital allocation approach.

risks.title: Sensitivity to Economic Cycles and Real Estate Markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned first in the 10-K with strong language (material adverse effect). It concerns the majority of the company's sales linked to construction and remodeling, sectors highly sensitive to interest rates and inflation. The Macro category is heavily weighted during periods of economic tensions.

risks.title: International Competition and Downward Price Pressure
risks.score_rationale: The factor is described as a major risk with mention of dumping, foreign subsidies and competitive innovation. The language is repeated and emphasized, indicating a structural threat. The Competition category is critical in a mature industry.

risks.title: Risks Related to Russian Operations
risks.score_rationale: The Russia risk is detailed across multiple paragraphs, with mention of sanctions, foreign exchange restrictions, expropriation risks and significant cash blockage. The language is alarming and specific. The Geopolitical category is currently highly weighted.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: 46% of sales are international, with significant exposure to translation of results. The risk is repeated in multiple sections with moderate but consistent language. The Macro category is systemic.

risks.title: Difficulty Anticipating Consumer Preferences
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly linked to innovation and rapid trends in the flooring sector. Mention of rapid changes and material impact. The Industrial category is central to product strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: MHK does not have significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the excerpts provided.
